column1: # The game's counts that only a Collection Log page shows, read as the page opens: page<TAB>slot<TAB>label<TAB>card.
# page is the page's key (its name as ClogService.bossToCategory keys it). slot is the varp that carries the line:
# 1 COLLECTION_CATEGORY_COUNT, 2 COLLECTION_CATEGORY_COUNT2, 3 COLLECTION_CATEGORY_COUNT3, as the game's page script
# writes it ([proc,collection_category_count], osrs-dumps 11/3). label is the line as the game writes it, up to its
# colon; it is also the count's name in the sync. card is a raid card's label for its own line under the raid's,
# else -: the count leads the page's card, as the game's page does. The choice of lines is Dylan's (11/6).
